blurb: Guests can choose from fishing charters including nearshore, deep-sea, fly fishing, or customize trips for birdwatching, nature tours, and scenic cruises. Trips range from 2 to 8 hours and can include family explorer days and sunset cruises. The captain provides all fishing gear, licenses, and guidance, with options for teaching kids and birdwatching.
